signUp.noFacilitySignIn: Already have an account? Sign in

reset.mismatch: Those two passwords do not match.

fields.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, and not a password known to have been breached.

notices.enterEmailFirst: Enter your email first, then choose Forgot password.
notices.resetSent: If that address has an account, we've emailed a link to reset the password.
notices.resetOpenLink: Open the link in that email to choose a new password. You can close this page.
notices.alreadyHaveAccountAt: That email already has an account, and the same password works here. Sign in and you can join {name}.
notices.alreadyHaveAccountPlain: That email already has an account. Sign in with it and you're straight in.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcome: Welcome back! Here's what's happening today 🐾

facilityConfig.title: Facility Configuration
facilityConfig.configDescription: Configure global settings that apply to all facilities in the platform, including service availability, pricing structures, booking rules, and operational policies.
facilityConfig.configWarning: Some configuration changes may be destructive and could affect existing bookings, pricing, or facility operations. Please review changes carefully before saving.

bookings.title: Bookings Management
bookings.searchBookings: Search by booking ID, client, or pet...
bookings.noBookingsMessage: There are no bookings in this category yet.

validation.maxLength: Must be no more than {max} characters

adminRoles.salesTeamDesc: Manages leads, client acquisition, and sales processes
adminRoles.technicalSupportDesc: Handles customer support tickets and technical issues
adminRoles.financialAuditorDesc: Reviews financial data and ensures compliance
adminRoles.systemAdministratorDesc: Full system access with administrative privileges

index.title: Settings
index.description: Configure your facility settings and preferences
index.noMatchHint: Try a different word, or the area it belongs to.

business.logoHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Square works best — it appears on receipts and invoices.
business.logoStillLoading: Still loading — try again in a moment.
business.logoTooLarge: That file is over 2 MB. Try a smaller image.
business.logoWrongType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
business.temperatureNote: Changing the temperature unit converts your existing weather warning thresholds to match.

hours.blockReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Closed for Christmas, Closed for staff training
hours.serviceDayBlockingHelp: Block specific calendar days for one or more services (e.g. daycare closed on Christmas) without changing the regular weekly schedule. On blocked dates, customers cannot book and staff cannot create bookings unless overridden by admin/manager.
hours.servicesAffected: Services affected (per service, multiple, or all)
hours.blockTypeHelp: Fully close = no check-in or check-out. Or block only check-in or only check-out dates.
hours.closureMessageHelp: Shown when a customer hovers over or focuses the blocked date in the booking calendar.
hours.noBlocks: No service-specific blocks. Add a date and service(s) above.
hours.oneDayScheduleHelp: Set custom opening and closing times for a specific date (e.g. a holiday) without changing the regular weekly schedule. Choose per service, multiple services, or all services.
hours.noOneDayOverrides: No one-day overrides. Add a date and times above.
hours.dropOffPickUpHelp: Override drop-off and pick-up windows for specific dates (e.g. holiday hours). Customers only see valid time options for each date.
hours.noDropOffOverrides: No drop-off/pick-up overrides. Add a date and service(s) above.

hq.title: HQ and multi-location
hq.intro: Head-office controls for businesses with more than one branch — an overview, comparison between locations, reporting, a shared service catalogue, a staff pool and transfers.

locations.onlyOne: You have one location. Add another from Multi-location (HQ) when you open a second branch.

language.title: Language and region
language.intro: Choose the languages your software runs in, and whether customers may state a preferred one when they sign up.
language.modeHelp: Run in English only, or turn on bilingual mode so forms and translated content can be used in both languages.
language.enableSecondaryHelp: Turn this off to run in one language only.
language.customerPreferenceHelp: When this is on, customers choose a preferred language while creating their account. Staff see it on the client profile and in messaging.
language.customerOptionsOff: Customers are not asked for a preferred language.

branding.loginPageHelp: This is what your customers and staff see at your own web address, before they sign in.
branding.logoHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. No logo is fine — your name is shown instead.
branding.wordmarkHelp: Optional. Your name drawn as an image, for the top of your sign-in page. Used there in preference to the logo.
branding.brandColourHex: Brand colour, as a hex value
branding.taglineHelp: Shown under your name on the sign-in card.
branding.supportHelp: Support details are for your signed-in screens. They are not published on the sign-in page.
branding.previewHelp: Approximate — the real page uses your own web address.
branding.signupHelp: Whether a pet owner who finds your page can register themselves as your customer.
branding.signupAtAddress: Anyone who signs in at {host} can join {facility} and start booking.
branding.signupAtOwnAddress: Anyone who signs in at your own web address can join {facility} and start booking.
branding.signupOffNote: Turning this off does not lock out the customers you already have. Anyone your team has added can still link their sign-in to the record waiting for them — this only decides whether people you have never met can create new ones.

weather.title: Yipyy Forecast
weather.intro: Automatic weather alerts, so the animals in your care are moved before the weather arrives.
weather.alertMessagePlaceholder: What should staff see on the dashboard?
weather.suggestedActionPlaceholder: e.g. Move all dogs to indoor areas
weather.nameAndMessageRequired: A rule needs a name and a message.

vaccination-requirements.intro: Choose which vaccines are required for each kind of animal. Customers are asked for these, and staff check them before a booking goes ahead.
vaccination-requirements.unreviewed: This is the standard list Yipyy ships. Nobody at this facility has reviewed it yet — it is still being checked on every booking.
vaccination-requirements.noneForSpecies: No vaccines set for {species}. Add one below.

incident-reporting.intro: Defaults and safeguards for how staff report and follow up on incidents.
incident-reporting.chargeMedsHelp: Bill owners for medications the facility gives during an incident’s in-stay care.
incident-reporting.feePerAdmin: Flat fee each time it is given
incident-reporting.feeOneTime: One-time flat fee, when the medication is added
incident-reporting.defaultAssigneeHelp: Pre-filled as the assignee on new protocol steps. Staff can change it per step.
incident-reporting.assigneeReporter: The staff member who reported it
incident-reporting.assigneeAnyStaff: Front desk, or any available staff
incident-reporting.requirePhoto: Require a photo on critical incidents
incident-reporting.requirePhotoHelp: When this is on, filing a critical incident is blocked until at least one photo is attached.
incident-reporting.autoNotifyHelp: Who is told automatically when an incident of each severity is reported.

form-requirements.title: Form requirements per service
form-requirements.intro: Choose which forms are required before customers can book, staff can approve, or a pet can be checked in. A form can block the step, or let it through with a warning.
form-requirements.stageBeforeBookingHelp: The customer completes it before requesting a booking
form-requirements.stageBeforeApprovalHelp: Staff cannot approve the booking until it is submitted
form-requirements.stageBeforeCheckinHelp: Required before the pet can be checked in
form-requirements.noneForService: No forms required here. Customers can book freely.
form-requirements.summaryNone: No forms required — customers can book freely
form-requirements.allFormsAdded: Every available form is already added
form-requirements.previewNoFields: This form has no fields yet.
form-requirements.previewUnavailable: This form's fields are not available to preview.
form-requirements.previewUnpublished: It may not be published at this facility yet.

audit.intro: Every change to this facility's records, and who made it.
audit.loadFailed: Could not read the audit trail.

boarding.intro: Boarding module setup — pricing, evaluation, media and basic details.

daycare.intro: Daycare module setup — pricing, evaluation, media and basic details.

grooming.intro: Grooming module setup — scheduling, pricing, add-ons, stylists and policies.

service-modules.calendarColourHelp: Used on the operations calendar and on badges when colour mode is set to service type.

custom-email-domain.intro: Send booking confirmations, reminders and receipts from your own domain instead of ours.
custom-email-domain.notAvailableHelp: Your email still goes out from Yipyy, and it is delivering normally. Nothing here needs your attention — we will get in touch when you can move it to your own domain.

employment-types.intro: The employment types offered when hiring or editing a staff member.
employment-types.none: No employment types yet — add one below.

termination-reasons.intro: The reasons offered when a staff member is terminated in the status-change dialog. Edit, add or remove any of them.
termination-reasons.none: No reasons yet — add one below.

integrations.callingMovedHelp: Your number, call routing, voicemail and missed-call replies now live under Communication → Calling.
integrations.accountingHelp: Post every sale, payment and refund to your books.
integrations.payHelp: Card payments, tips and payouts. Managed under Financial → Payments and billing.
integrations.qbHelp: Send sales, payments and refunds straight to your accountant's books.

notifications.templateEditorHelp: Customise your email and SMS templates, under Communication → Templates.
notifications.roleDefaultsHelp: What each role's notifications start with. New staff accounts are seeded from these, and each person can change their own afterwards.
notifications.bookingDefaultsHelp: The notification channels pre-selected when confirming each service. Staff can still change them per booking.
notifications.settingsHelp: Choose which notifications are sent, and through which channels.

smart-insights.intro: Control which insights run, how you are notified, and the thresholds that decide when an insight fires.
smart-insights.enableHelp: When this is off, the Smart insights page, the dashboard widget and the nav badge are hidden for everyone at this facility.
smart-insights.digestToggle: Send the morning digest at 7 a.m.
smart-insights.digestHelp: A one-glance summary of the top insights generated overnight, sent to the owner and manager addresses.
smart-insights.categoriesHelp: Turn off any category you do not want surfaced. Disabled insights still run in the background — they just do not appear in lists.
smart-insights.thresholdsHelp: Tighten or loosen any of the values that decide when an insight fires. Leave a field blank to use the system default.
smart-insights.thresholdChurnHelp: Fires when days since the last visit exceed the average cadence multiplied by this number
smart-insights.thresholdOvertimeHelp: Overtime spend over the labour budget that triggers an insight
smart-insights.thresholdCancellationHelp: The week-over-90-day spike that triggers a high-severity insight
smart-insights.thresholdDepositsHelp: Outstanding deposit total that triggers an insight
smart-insights.thresholdNoShowHelp: Revenue lost to no-shows per month that triggers a high-severity insight
smart-insights.thresholdMissedCallsHelp: Daily missed-call count that triggers an insight
smart-insights.thresholdVoicemailCountHelp: Unheard voicemails that trigger the backlog insight
smart-insights.thresholdVoicemailAgeHelp: Hours before any voicemail counts as too old
smart-insights.thresholdInboxHelp: Hours before the slow-response insight fires
smart-insights.thresholdStationHelp: Average minutes waiting to be cleaned before the insight fires
smart-insights.thresholdGroomingHelp: Share of tasks automatically marked missed before the insight fires

staff-notifications.intro: Choose which onboarding and offboarding events notify your team, and on which channels. Turn any trigger off to stop it entirely.

subscription.moduleAddOnsHelp: Turn on extra modules to extend what Yipyy does for you.

retail.denied: Retail settings are open to facility owners and managers only.
retail.intro: Set up the product categories, suppliers, brands, tags and units your retail module uses.
retail.defaultPricingHelp: How new products are priced to begin with. Each product can still override this on its own page.
retail.defaultMarginHelp: Pre-fills the margin field when a new product is created in margin mode.
retail.roundingWhole: Up to the next whole dollar
retail.roundingHelp: Applies to every margin-calculated price — the product form, brand rules and invoice import. It changes future calculations only, and does not re-round prices already set.
retail.taxHelp: One source of truth for point-of-sale and invoice tax. Replaces the tax logic that used to be hardcoded into the till.
retail.defaultTaxRateHelp: Applied to every taxable product unless it overrides it
retail.showTaxBreakdown: Show the tax breakdown on receipts
retail.showTaxBreakdownHelp: Itemise each tax line on printed and emailed receipts.
retail.exemptCategoriesHelp: Products in an exempt category are sold without tax.
retail.exemptCategoriesEmpty: Add product categories above to set up exemptions.
retail.renameBrandHelp: Updates the name on every product using this brand and on its margin rule, so brand-rule pricing keeps matching.
retail.lowStockThresholdHelp: Alert me when any product falls below this many units. Per-product overrides are set on the product's own page.
retail.lowStockNotify: Send low-stock alerts to staff notifications
retail.lowStockNotifyHelp: Post an alert to the staff notifications channel when a product hits its threshold.
retail.receiptsHelp: How point-of-sale receipts look, and how they reach customers.
retail.receiptHeaderPlaceholder: Shown at the top of the receipt — your store name and address, for example
retail.receiptFooterPlaceholder: e.g. Thank you for shopping with us.
retail.receiptFormatHelp: How receipts are handed over at checkout.
retail.receiptLogoHelp: Print the facility logo at the top of the receipt.
retail.returnPolicyPlaceholder: e.g. Returns accepted within 30 days with a receipt.
retail.returnPolicyHelp: Printed near the bottom of every receipt.
retail.testSentPrint: Test receipt sent to the printer
retail.testSentBoth: Test receipt sent to the printer and by email
retail.addressPlaceholder: Street, city, province and postal code
retail.name: Name
retail.notesPlaceholder: Special instructions, minimum orders, and so on

yipyy-pay.loadFailed: Yipyy Pay could not be loaded.
yipyy-pay.notAvailable: Yipyy Pay is not available yet
yipyy-pay.notAvailableHelp: Card payments have not been switched on for this Yipyy installation. Nothing is wrong with your business — contact Yipyy support and we will enable it.
yipyy-pay.whichBusinessHelp: You administer more than one facility and this address does not say which. Open the one you want at its own address — a payment account belongs to a business, not to an account.
yipyy-pay.applicationLoadFailed: Your application could not be loaded.
yipyy-pay.needLegalName: Your legal business name and tax number
yipyy-pay.needPhotoId: Photo ID for everyone who owns 25% or more
yipyy-pay.needBank: The bank account your payouts should reach
yipyy-pay.needTerminal: Your card terminal, if you have one
yipyy-pay.landingTitle: Take payments, tips and deposits without leaving Yipyy.
yipyy-pay.landingBody: Card on the terminal, a link by text, an invoice by email — all of it lands on the booking it belongs to, and all of it pays out to your own bank account.
yipyy-pay.beforeYouStartHelp: Applying takes about fifteen minutes if you have these to hand. You can save and come back at any point.
yipyy-pay.legalNameWarning: Your legal business name must match your tax records exactly.
yipyy-pay.linkExisting: Link the one you have instead
yipyy-pay.holdingHelp: What we are holding, and for how long.
yipyy-pay.connectHelp: Yipyy Pay pays out through a Clover merchant account in your own business name. Sign in to yours to link it — or open one on the way through if you do not have one yet.
yipyy-pay.lastAttemptFailed: The last attempt did not finish.
yipyy-pay.connectSecureNote: You will be taken to a secure page to sign in.
yipyy-pay.checkBusinessHelp: This is what your merchant account holds. Make sure it is the right business before you start taking money into it.
yipyy-pay.stillSettingUp: Your account is still being set up on Clover's side.
yipyy-pay.stillSettingUpHelp: This usually settles within a few minutes of the account being approved. A brand-new business tax number can take longer, because it has to reach the tax authority's own records first. Nothing here needs doing — check back, or finish anything Clover is still asking you for.
yipyy-pay.terminalReadyOnlineNot: Card payments on your terminal are ready. Online payments — payment links and emailed invoices — need one more key from Clover that has not arrived yet. You can finish setup now and it will start working on its own.
yipyy-pay.testAccountHelp: Cards are not really charged and no money reaches your bank. Connect your live account when you are ready to trade.
yipyy-pay.wrongBusiness: Wrong business? Use a different account
yipyy-pay.receiptNameTooLong: Shorten the receipt name before finishing.
yipyy-pay.preferencesHelp: The last step, and all of it stays in Yipyy. You can change any of this later.
yipyy-pay.whenPaidHelp: Your payout schedule is set on your merchant account. Tell us which one you are on and we will show you when money should land.
yipyy-pay.payoutEstimateNote: This changes the dates Yipyy estimates — it does not change your schedule. To change the schedule itself, do it on your merchant account.
yipyy-pay.customerSeesHelp: The name printed on receipts, invoices and payment emails from Yipyy.
yipyy-pay.statementNote: The line on your customer's bank statement is separate and is set on your merchant account, not here.
yipyy-pay.passOnNotReady: Passing the fee on to customers is not switched on yet. It changes what a customer is charged, so it needs the invoice, the receipt and the refund to agree about it — and the rules differ by country and by state. For now Yipyy Pay absorbs it into your takings.
yipyy-pay.nextNameTerminal: Next: name your card terminal so staff can tell one from another at checkout.
yipyy-pay.disconnected: Your payment account is no longer connected. This happens if the app was removed from your merchant account.
yipyy-pay.cardPaymentsDown: Card payments are not working right now.
yipyy-pay.lastSyncNote: The last check for changes made at Clover was {when}. It normally runs every 15 minutes.
yipyy-pay.pendingUpdatesOne: One update from Clover has been received but not applied.
yipyy-pay.pendingUpdatesMany: {count} updates from Clover have been received but not applied.
yipyy-pay.refundsMayNotReach: Refunds made in Clover may not be reaching Yipyy
yipyy-pay.moneyOnItsWay: Money on its way to your bank
yipyy-pay.moneyOnItsWayHelp: Estimated from the card payments you have taken. Clover settles the final amount.
yipyy-pay.nothingSettling: Nothing is waiting to settle. Card payments you take today will appear here with the date they should reach your bank.
yipyy-pay.noPaymentsYetHelp: Take one at checkout, or send a customer a payment link, and it will show up here with the booking it belongs to.
yipyy-pay.readersFailed: Your card readers could not be listed. This usually means the payment account needs reconnecting.
yipyy-pay.noReaderYetHelp: You can already take payments online — a payment link or an emailed invoice needs no hardware. A card reader is for taking the card in front of you at the counter.
yipyy-pay.modelNotDrivable: This model cannot be driven from a web app. A Clover Flex, Mini or Compact can.
yipyy-pay.tippingAtReaderHelp: Your readers ask for a tip during the sale, using the tiers set in Yipyy. There is nothing to push to a device — change the tiers and the next payment uses them.
yipyy-pay.addingReaderHelp: You do not pair a reader with Yipyy. It belongs to your payment account, and it appears here on its own once it is running.
yipyy-pay.nameReadersHelp: Give each reader a name as soon as it appears — “Front desk”, “Grooming room”. Two readers of the same model are otherwise told apart only by their serial, and picking the wrong one sends the card request to another room.
yipyy-pay.nameThisReaderHelp: Staff pick a reader by this name at checkout. Say where it is.
yipyy-pay.name: Name
yipyy-pay.customerSeesShortHelp: The name Yipyy prints on receipts, invoices and payment emails.
yipyy-pay.feeCost: Card payments cost {reader} on your reader and {online} online.
yipyy-pay.statementNoteShort: The line on your customer's bank statement is separate. It belongs to your merchant account and is changed there.
yipyy-pay.passOnNotReadyShort: Passing the fee on is not switched on yet.
yipyy-pay.estimateNoteShort: This setting changes the dates Yipyy estimates, not your schedule.
yipyy-pay.tippingHelp: Tip tiers, prompts and reminders live in their own screen so there is only one place to change them.
yipyy-pay.preauthHelp: Place a small temporary hold to check a card is good before the appointment.
yipyy-pay.whenPaidShortHelp: Set on your merchant account. Tell us which one you are on and we will estimate arrival dates.
yipyy-pay.paymentsFailed: The payments could not be read.
yipyy-pay.sellingOneCheckoutBody: Terminal, online invoice and payment link all settle to the same account and land on the same booking.
yipyy-pay.sellingTipsBody: On-screen tipping at the terminal, tied to the booking and the staff who did the work.
yipyy-pay.sellingFollowBody: Every card payment and refund is on the booking it belongs to, so the day reconciles itself.
yipyy-pay.sellingOwnBody: The merchant account is in your business name and payouts go straight to your own bank. Yipyy never holds your funds and never sees a card number.
yipyy-pay.draftHeadline: Your application is still a draft
yipyy-pay.submittedBody: We check it over, then pass it to the provider who opens your merchant account. You do not need to do anything.
yipyy-pay.reviewBody: This is the part that takes the longest and it is out of our hands. If anything more is needed, it will appear here.
yipyy-pay.moreInfoBody: Underwriting has come back with a question. Answer it and your application carries on from where it was.
yipyy-pay.approvedBody: One step left: link it to Yipyy so payments can start reaching your bookings.
yipyy-pay.rejectedBody: The reason is below. You can start a new application once whatever it names has been dealt with.
yipyy-pay.payoutStandardHelp: Money reaches your bank two to three business days after you take it.
yipyy-pay.payoutNextDayHelp: Available on some accounts once you have been trading a while. Check your Clover account.
yipyy-pay.needLegalNameDetail: Exactly as your tax records show them — capitalisation, punctuation and any Inc., Ltd. or LLC included.
yipyy-pay.needPhotoIdDetail: Passport, driving licence or national ID card, plus their date of birth, home address and identity number.
yipyy-pay.needBankDetail: In the business name, not a personal account, with a void cheque or bank letter to prove it.
yipyy-pay.needTerminalDetail: A Clover Flex, Mini or Compact. You can apply without one and add it later.
yipyy-pay.stepYouSubmitDetail: Your application is locked so it cannot change under review.
yipyy-pay.stepUnderwritingDetail: They check the business, the owners and the documents. They may come back with a question.
yipyy-pay.stepAccountOpenedDetail: In your business name, with payouts to the account you gave.
yipyy-pay.stepLinkedDetail: Then terminal, link and invoice payments all land on the booking they belong to.
yipyy-pay.neverSwept: Nothing has ever checked this connection for changes made at Clover.
yipyy-pay.stillSettingUpWhy: Until the country and currency are settled, a card cannot be charged — Yipyy refuses rather than guessing, because guessing wrong charges a customer in the wrong money.
yipyy-pay.testAccountSimulated: Cards are simulated, no money reaches your bank, and the figures below are not real takings.

customer.notRegistered: You are not registered here yet
customer.notRegisteredBody: You are signed in, but this facility does not have an account for you. Your pets and bookings at other facilities are unaffected.

employee.clockOutUndone: Clock-out undone — back on the clock
employee.closeRegisterFirst: Count & close the register before logging out.
employee.registerClosed: Register closed — drawer reconciled. See you next shift!
employee.registerOpened: Register opened — have a great shift!
employee.startYourDay: Start your day — count the drawer
employee.openNotePlaceholder: Anything worth flagging at open — e.g. low on quarters.
employee.closingNotePlaceholder: Anything the next staff should know.
employee.managerNotePlaceholder: Why is the drawer off? What should be checked?
employee.lockWarning: Locking this session prevents further changes — only the manager note can be edited later.
employee.countStep: Count every coin and bill in the drawer right now. We'll compare your count to what the system tracked through the day.
employee.reviewStep: Review the breakdown. Locking confirms today's session is done — only the manager note can change after.
employee.openGateBody: Count the opening float and open the register for {location} before serving the first customer — it reconciles the cash from the first sale.
employee.hrRecordsOne: You have {count} HR record to review and acknowledge.
employee.hrRecordsMany: You have {count} HR records to review and acknowledge.
employee.signedInAs: Signed in as {name}. The portal unlocks once the register is open.
employee.priorDrawerAfter: — start fresh, don't copy that number blindly.

admin.searchPlaceholder: Search facilities, invoices, tickets, team, announcements…
